target: Delta Thv(t+15)=Thv(t+15)-Thv(t), restored to absolute Thv for metrics
history_input: all enabled raw signals through forecast origin t
known_future_control_input: all enabled raw valve commands u(t)..u(t+14)
training_loss: weighted Huber; train-defined lowest-delta 10% receives weight 3
test_policy: Training, preflight and validation summary never deserialize test_clean.pkl or test_full_clean.pkl.
coarse_region_rule: cells with mean validation RMSE no greater than the global minimum mean plus the standard error of that minimum cell
replication_note: five seeds quantify optimization variability and are not five independent process experiments
